try: Open {url}. The experiment settled-input is ON for this demo only (/flag shows it and where it comes from). Type a sentence and pause, e.g. "Is the envelope ready?": after 1.8 s a quiet "send? (Tab to send, keep typing to ignore)" appears. Nothing is sent until you press a key.
Press Tab: it sends. Or keep typing (the offer goes, settle_ignore is logged), or Escape. An unfinished line ("and then," / "see e.g." / "wait...") gets no offer.
Enter still sends at any time, offer or not (enter_send). /stats ends with an "experiments" block: offers, Tab, ignored, Enter with and without an offer, time from the last keystroke to the send.
/flag settled-input off restores the default (no offer, Tab moves focus again); it is kept in {dir}/flags.json. /flag settled-input on brings it back.
